player_prompt.intro:
As-salamu ɛalaykum di Taburt n Wewras!

Tura d-ketted ɣef 'P' di tɣimit.
Ismilen n tɣimit:
  ' ' = Afar n wewras (ameɣtuɣ)
  'H' = Tixxamt (ɣlin dɣa tɣeddeḍ!)
  'G' = Ammud (ɛiwed-iyiɣ ar tazwara!)
  'P' = Adeg-ik n tura

Tidyanin yellan: ɣer ufella, ɣer wadda, ɣer tama tazelmaṭ, ɣer tama tayeffust (neɣ w, a, s, d)
Arki tidi-ik s: [up], [down], [left], [right] neɣ [w], [a], [s], [d]

Amḍiq: ɛiwed-iyiɣ seg tazwara (deg ufella-tazelmaṭ) ɣer ammud (deg wadda-tayeffust) war ma tɣeddeḍ di tixxamin!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tidi ur nelli d aɣawas. Arki [up], [down], [left], [right] neɣ [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: Taɣawsa ur nettwassen '{action}'. Sseqdec ar, ɣer daxel, azelmaḍ, ayeffus neɣ w, a, s, d.
invalid_move.hit_wall: Teɛreḍ ad tgerzeḍ {action} maca tewwteḍ ɣer lḥiḍ!

outcome.fell_in_hole: Teɣliḍ deg useklu! Tazrigt tekfa. Tjemɛeḍ {pct}% n webrid ɣer lbal-nni.
outcome.turn_limit: Tessawḍeḍ ar uswir n uḥric! Taggara. Tesɛeddaḍ {pct}% seg webrid ɣer yiswi.
